# Ayuda '?' de la V1600G0-B V1.4.8R (OLT_VIOTA, 2026-10-08). Solo consultas de ayuda: ninguna
# línea se ejecutó. Las de "onu 6 pri …" en interface gpon 0/1; las de "user …" en config.

===== user ?
user
  add              Add User to System
  delete           Delete one user from system.
  enable-password  Set user's enable password.
  list             List all users in system
  login-password   Set user's login password.
  manage           Manage System's users.
  role             Change User's system role

===== user login-password ?
user login-password
  <username>  Input username that you want to set login password.

===== user login-password admin ?
user login-password admin
  <cr>  Just Press Enter to Execute command!

===== user enable-password ?
user enable-password
  <username>  Input username that you want to set enable password.

===== user enable-password admin ?
user enable-password admin
  <cr>  Just Press Enter to Execute command!

===== onu 6 pri ?
onu 6 pri
  acl                      Specify ONU acl.
  ap                       Specify ONU AP configuration.
  dhcp_server              Specify ONU DHCP Server.
  dhcp_server_ipv6         Specify ONU DHCP Server ipv6 configuration.
  factory_reset            Specify onu factory and reset control.
  mac_clean                Specify onu mac clean control.
  save_config              Specify onu save configuration control.
  firewall                 Specify ONU firewall.
  h248_param_config        Specify H.248 Server config.
  h248_signal_media_alone  Specify H.248 Signal/Media Alone Setting.
  h248_user_config         Specify H.248 User config.
  lan_bind_mode            Specify lan binding mode.
  loopback_detect          Specify ONU loopback detection configuration.
  mac_acl_group            Specify mac acl group configuration.
  mac_acl_rule             Specify mac acl rule configuration.
  mac_aging_time           Specify onu mac aging time.
  mac_limit                Specify onu mac limit.
  mqtt                     Specify ONU MQTT configuration.
  nat_type                 Specify Nat Type configuration.
  omci                     omci  Specify omci information.
  onu_mode                 Specify ONU Mode configuration.
  onu_selfdiag_alarm       Specify ONU Self Diagnosis Alarm configuration.
  onu_selfdiag_capture     Specify ONU Self Diagnosis Capture Package configuration.
  onu_selfdiagnosis        Specify ONU Self Diagnosis configuration.
  port_isolate             Specify onu port isolate.
  spanning_tree            Specify onu spanning tree.
  catv                     Specify onu catv operation.
  igmp                     Specify onu igmp operation.
  reset_button             Specify ONU reset button control configuration.
  sip_digit_map            Sip Digit map config.
  sip_global_param         Sip param config.
  speed_limit              Specify onu speed limit.
  tr069_mng                Specify ONU tr069 manage configuration.
  tr069_stun               Specify tr069 stun configuration.
  upnp                     Specify UPnP configuration.
  username                 Specify ONU username administration.
  voip_global_param        Specify voip global ip vlan param config.
  voip_timer               Specify voip timer information.
  wan_adv                  Specify ONU wan connection advance.
  wan_conn                 Specify ONU wan connection.
  wifi_ssid                Specify onu wifi ssid.
  wifi_switch              Specify ONU wifi_switch.
  equid                    Equipment ID.
  pots                     Specify voip pots information.
  type                     Onu Type.

===== onu 6 pri username ?
onu 6 pri username
  admin_control  Specify ONU admin control.

===== onu 6 pri username admin ?
onu 6 pri username admin
  disable  Specify ONU admin control disable.
  enable   Specify ONU admin control enable.

===== onu 6 pri tr069_mng ?
onu 6 pri tr069_mng
  disable  Specify disable function.
  enable   Specify enable function.

===== onu 6 pri acl ?
onu 6 pri acl
  show    Specify ONU acl show.
  telnet  Specify ONU acl telnet.
  ftp     Specify ONU acl ftp.
  http    Specify ONU acl http.
  https   Specify ONU acl https.
  tftp    Specify ONU acl tftp.
  ping    Specify ONU acl ping.
  ssh     Specify ONU acl ssh.

===== onu 6 pri acl http ?
onu 6 pri acl http
  control  Specify ONU acl control.

===== onu 6 pri acl http control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable ?
onu 6 pri acl http control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable
  port  Specify ONU protocol port.
  <cr>  Just Press Enter to Execute command!

===== onu 6 pri firewall ?
onu 6 pri firewall
  level  Specify ONU firewall level.

===== onu 6 pri firewall level ?
onu 6 pri firewall level
  disable  Specify ONU firewall level disable.
  high     Specify ONU firewall level high.
  low      Specify ONU firewall level low.
  middle   Specify ONU firewall level middle.
